title: thalictrum minus var. stipellatum
intro: Thalictrum minus var. stipellatum, commonly known as meadow rue, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an anti-spasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of meadow rue are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce pain, and lower fever. The bioactive constituents of meadow rue include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
